integrity: All normalized binary monotonic transition pairs through three states are exhaustively enumerated. Two independently implemented game solvers, one on full active subsets and one on endpoint pairs, agree on every case. The representative has an explicit reset word and an explicit stationary winning response for Bob.
scientific_limitations: The exact census is restricted to complete deterministic binary monotonic automata with at most three states. The count of four exceptional ordered pairs is for a fixed normalized preserved order and does not count abstract automata with all possible preserved orders.
title: Three states are minimal for a monotonic synchronization-game separation
